functions.name: fork
functions.desc: Delegate a subtask to a helper agent. Use join(id) to get a helper's result.         You can call this multiple times to take multiple actions. Do not delegate the entire task you were given.         If the user's query can be resolved in parallel, call this multiple times then use join("all").

json_schema.description: Delegate a subtask to a helper agent. Use join(id) to get a helper's result.         You can call this multiple times to take multiple actions. Do not delegate the entire task you were given.         If the user's query can be resolved in parallel, call this multiple times then use join("all").

instructions.description: Detailed instructions on what your helper should do to help you. This should include all the information the helper needs.

json_schema.title: fork

functions.name: join
functions.desc: Wait for spawned helper agents to complete and retrieve their results.         Pass the agent IDs returned by `fork`, "all", or "next".         Returns the final responses from each agent.

json_schema.description: Wait for spawned helper agents to complete and retrieve their results.         Pass the agent IDs returned by `fork`, "all", or "next".         Returns the final responses from each agent.

id.description: The id of the subagent. Pass "next" for the next helper, or "all" for all running subagents.
